runbook: R-18/R-19 as amended 2026-08-14 (R-15/R-18 amendment clauses 1 and 3)
investigator: fresh independent oracle; evidence tree = `git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md` only, plus the corrected brief

supersedes.recorded_defect_in_the_prior_brief: The prior brief posed a VALUE question ('is 1.12 the right multiplier for Abyssal Mask's Unmake?') about what the identity-keyed classification calls a FIELD REMOVAL from a record both sides hold. The investigator derived 1.12 from the cached item text correctly and certified it, but magnitude was never in dispute: the change is about which engine prices the amplifier, not what it is worth. The prior brief further asserted the record's siblings unmoved by omission, when the same correction moved three fields of the record — `damage` and `pair_damage` alongside `support_damage_multiplier` itself. That is the false premise the 2026-08-14 R-18 amendment names in terms; this receipt answers the field across the whole event list, as the amendment's remedy requires.

question_as_corrected: For each event of this roster's combat log, does a support-damage multiplier apply to it, what is its magnitude, and which participant's engine is entitled to publish it?

sources.text: Immobilizing an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.

sources.note: checked — sections 0–6 cover renewal/expectation timing, the 100/(100+R) identity, pen/reduction composition, BIS and variance. It is silent on support-item target-side amplifiers and on record-field publication ownership, so it neither licenses nor forbids the field; the ruling rests on the cached item text plus the committed pre-change series.
committed pre-change series for mandate_abyssal_curse_roster/combat/events at 58a43a6 (facts of the question under the R-18 amendment)

sources_absent_from_the_evidence_tree: The committed definition of `mandate_abyssal_curse_roster` (levels, builds, ability ranks) is not carried by `data/` or `docs/math-foundations.md`, and the corrected brief cites it without quoting it. The ruling therefore does not depend on it: every step below is derived from the cached item text and from internal consistency of the committed pre-change series itself.

computation.step_1_identify_the_leaf_record: Zero-indexing the committed pre-change event list: [0] main E magic; [1..3] ally:Pantheon W/E/R at t=0.0; [4] ally:Pantheon Q t=0.1 (field 1.07 Imperial Mandate); [5,6] enemy:Aatrox Q; [7] main Q magic (1.12); [8] main Q true (1.12); [9,10] main damage_amp_Imperial Mandate 9.9/13.8; [11] main W (1.12); [12] main R magic, event_id main:enemy:Aatrox:7, sequence 8, t=0.5, raw 218.8, damage 186.8, field {1.12, Abyssal Mask — Unmake}. Leaf confirmed.
computation.step_2_what_the_two_amplifiers_are: Both live amplifiers are TARGET-side, not attacker-side. Unmake curses enemies within 700 units of the holder so that they 'receive 12% increased magic damage from all sources' — magic damage only, and explicitly from every attacker including the holder. Command marks an immobilized enemy Vulnerable for 4s, 'increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%' — every damage type. Neither is a property of any one attacker; each is a property of enemy:Aatrox's state, priced by whichever engine computes damage into that state.
computation.step_3_recover_the_ally_mitigation_facto: ally:Pantheon's two unamplified physical events pin the target's armor exactly. 207 × 100/220 = 94.091 → 94.1 (obs 94.1); 255 × 100/220 = 115.909 → 115.9 (obs 115.9). Armor factor = 0.4545455 (armor 120), shared by all of that attacker's physical events.
computation.step_4_the_ally_Q_silently_carries_the_c: Event [4] (Pantheon Q, physical, t=0.1, raw 430) publishes only {1.07, Imperial Mandate — Command}, but 430 × 0.4545455 × 1.07 = 209.14, not the recorded 234.2. Composite amp implied = 234.2 / 195.4545 = 1.19824. Candidates: 1.07 × 1.12 = 1.1984 → 234.23 → 234.2 (match); additive 1.19 → 232.6 (no); 1.20 → 234.5 (no). So the ally's damage was priced with BOTH the Mandate 7% and the Abyssal 12%, while the field named only one of them. The field is already lossy on the side where it is genuinely a cross-participant fact.
computation.step_5_the_Mandate_share_of_main_s_own_d: Every `damage_amp_Imperial Mandate` event equals exactly 7% of the corresponding main event's pre-Abyssal damage: true Q 197.5 × 0.07 = 13.83 → 13.8 (obs 13.8); magic Q (157.8/1.12) × 0.07 = 9.86 → 9.9 (obs 9.9); W (252.7/1.12) × 0.07 = 15.79 → 15.8 (obs 15.8); R (186.8/1.12) × 0.07 = 11.68 → 11.7 (obs 11.7, the leaf record's own amp partner main:enemy:Aatrox:8). Six for six. So the series' own convention for main's OWN damage is: main's engine prices its support-item amplifier and materializes it as its own attributed event — it never uses `support_damage_multiplier` for it.
computation.step_6_the_field_census_across_the_serie: The field occurs 11 times. Once on an ally event ([4], 1.07, Imperial Mandate) — an amplifier owned by a different participant than the attacker. Ten times on main's own events ([7],[8],[11],[12],[13],[14] and the later W t=3.95, Q×2 t=5.33, W t=7.4), always 1.12, always Abyssal Mask — an amplifier owned by the attacker itself. enemy:Aatrox's six events carry no field, correctly: no enemy-side support item is in the roster. Answering the field rather than one member: the entitled publisher is the engine that prices the amplifier from OUTSIDE the attacker's own damage pipeline. That is the roster/support layer for an ally's events; for main's own events the amplifier is main's own item inside main's own pipeline, exactly as the Mandate 7% already is in step 5, and it earns no `support_damage_multiplier`. The Abyssal entries on main's events are the single class of exception, and they are inconsistent with the same item-class amplifier on the same attacker.
computation.step_7_disposition_of_the_leaf: Two independent readings of the change both put the field absent at [12]. (a) Repricing: main's own damage engine prices the 12% curse inside main's amplifier chain (which is what 'from all sources' requires — the curse does amplify the wearer's own magic damage), and the roster layer stops annotating it; the field goes, the number stays real. (b) Ownership: `support_damage_multiplier` is a cross-participant attribution field, and self-amplification is not support damage. Under either, an attacker=main record must not carry the field. Verdict: new_value_correct. The magnitude 1.12 is not impeached — it is the correct Unmake magnitude for a magic event — which is precisely why the prior brief's value question could be answered correctly and still miss the defect.
step_8_out_of_leaf_flags: Unmake amplifies MAGIC damage only. The pre-change series applied 1.12 to non-magic damage twice over: main's true-damage Q instances ([8] 197.5 × 1.12 = 221.2 exactly, and its t=5.33 twin) — true damage ignores resistances and is not magic damage — and ally:Pantheon's physical Q ([4], shown in step 4). Those records are wrong on the magnitude question the prior brief asked, whereas the leaf record [12] is magic and is not.

Amplifier onset: no event at t=0.0 carries either amplifier ([0] main E: 239.4/346.2 = 0.69151 with no amp; [1],[2] at the bare armor factor; [3] Pantheon R magic unamplified), while every event from t=0.1 on does. A 700-unit proximity aura that is off for the first batch and on thereafter is a timing model worth confirming separately; it is a field-wide property, not a leaf defect.

If the post-change `damage` at [12] is 186.8 / 1.12 = 166.8, the curse was dropped from the holder's own magic damage rather than repriced, which would contradict 'from all sources'. That is the `damage`/`pair_damage` sibling question the amendment says must travel with this record; it is outside this leaf and this receipt does not rule on it. Any other moved value (e.g. an inline fold-in of the Mandate 7%, 166.79 × 1.12 × 1.07 = 199.9, retiring the separate damage_amp events) is consistent with repricing.

answer_to_the_field_question.does_a_support_multiplier_apply_to_the_l: Yes — enemy:Aatrox is cursed and Vulnerable at t=0.5, and the event is magic damage, so a 12% Unmake amplification (and, separately accounted, the Mandate 7%) genuinely reaches this damage.
answer_to_the_field_question.magnitude: 1.12 (Unmake, magic only) — uncontested and independently re-derived here from data/items.json 8020 and data/atoms/items.json objects.8020.
answer_to_the_field_question.entitled_publisher: main's own damage engine, inside main's damage number — not the roster/support layer's `support_damage_multiplier` annotation, which the series reserves (correctly at [4]) for an amplifier owned by a participant other than the attacker.
